Class HttpUtilsMockResponseGenerator

@IsTest
public class HttpUtilsMockResponseGenerator
implements HttpCalloutMock

Mock HTTP callout response generator used by HttpUtilsTest. Implements HttpCalloutMock to return configurable responses with custom status codes, body content (String or Blob), and headers.
